'''Ossus City''' was, according to [[Qel-Droma Epics]], a modest [[City|village]] located in a tranquil valley on the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] [[Ossus]], far from the [[Ooroo Canyon]], where the [[Great Jedi Library]] was supposedly located, and approximately fifty [[kilometer]]s from [[Knossa]].<ref name="Nexus" />

It was a place of recovery for the [[Jedi]], from wounds both physical and psychological. A [[Jedi temple (Ossus City)|small temple]] staffed by a rotating cast of young [[Jedi healer]]s provided primary care to the sick and wounded. Surrounding the temple were small cottages that slept four: one healer and three patients. Farther out were a variety of huts, cabins, and tents occupied by elderly Jedi seeking a quiet end in peaceful contemplation of [[the Force]]. While recovering, Jedi patients often visited with the older [[Jedi Master|Masters]], seeking wisdom and guidance.<ref name="Nexus" />
